name: GDLM Probe
description: Logs the player's state every physics tick and every press to a file, and plays GDLM routes (and main levels, in practice mode) back on exact ticks when GDLevelMaker asks (a play.json command file), and adds GDLM levels to My Levels while the game runs (an install inbox, checked on menus only). For GDLevelMaker's sim checks.

enabled.name: Log attempts
enabled.description: Write one JSON-lines file per attempt to the mod's save folder.

only-gdlm.name: Only GDLM levels
only-gdlm.description: Log only levels whose name starts with GDLM.
